concerns.text: FR-001 mandates ingestion from 'Materials Project, NIST, and UCI'. The plan explicitly states it 'cannot fulfill FR-001 as written' because no verified URL exists for Materials Project. The plan proposes a 'Coverage Gap' report instead of fulfilling the ingestion requirement. This leaves FR-001 unbacked by a functional implementation task.

FR-002 requires iterative imputation to handle missing values. The plan states the pipeline will 'halt' at Step 1 due to missing data columns. Consequently, the imputation logic (FR-002) is never executed, leaving the requirement unbacked by a task.
FR-003 requires training ElasticNet, RF, and GB models. The plan halts before modeling due to the data gap. No task exists to train these models, leaving FR-003 unbacked.
FR-004 requires calculating and reporting mean R² scores. Since the pipeline halts before training (see FR-003), no R² scores are calculated. This requirement is unbacked.
FR-005 requires statistical inference (t-tests, permutation tests, Bonferroni). The plan halts before this stage. No task exists to perform these tests, leaving FR-005 unbacked.
FR-006 requires generating prediction intervals via Quantile Regression Forests. The plan halts before inference. No task exists to generate these intervals, leaving FR-006 unbacked.

FR-007 requires enforcing memory limits and subsampling. The plan mentions this as a 'fallback' but the primary failure mode is a hard halt due to missing columns, not memory pressure. The specific logic to subsample when limits are approached is not the primary path and may not be tested if the data gap is the only failure mode.
FR-008 requires testing interaction terms and non-linear effects. The plan halts before modeling. No task exists to test these interactions, leaving FR-008 unbacked.
SC-001 requires measuring the mean R² score against a hypothesis threshold. Since the pipeline halts and produces no R² score (see FR-004), this success criterion cannot be measured.
SC-002 requires measuring row retention after imputation. Since the pipeline halts before imputation (see FR-002), no retention metric is generated.
SC-003 requires measuring the number of statistically significant predictors. Since the pipeline halts before inference (see FR-005), no significance metrics are generated.
SC-004 requires measuring prediction interval width. Since the pipeline halts before inference (see FR-006), no intervals are generated.

SC-005 requires measuring total execution time against a limit. While the pipeline runs briefly, the 'execution' is a failure check, not the full pipeline described in the spec. The success criterion implies a full run.
